pages.text: The $(d)Portkey$() is used to teleport whoever picks it up.$(br2)Right-click the Portkey on a block to set its destination. Then, throw it on the ground. After a short delay, it will activate.

Anyone who touches the activated Portkey will be teleported instantly to the destination, assuming it's in the same dimension.$(br2)You can craft the Portkey with any other item to disguise it, making it look like the item it was crafted with.
